extract.title: Strategy & Operations Lead
key_requirements: 6+ years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy or BizOps
Bachelor's degree; MBA or MPP a plus
extract.ai_evidence: Ledgerline builds AI agents that automate regulatory compliance
extract.funding_evidence: Ledgerline is a publicly traded company

score.explanation: Strong corporate S&O match: the candidate has built an annual operating plan and QBR cadence and led cross-functional initiatives. The main gap is financial-services domain experience, which is preferred rather than required.
requirements_met: Built annual operating plan and QBR cadence with CEO/CFO at Northwind
gaps: No financial services or compliance industry experience
No board-materials experience shown on resume

resume_bullets: Built Northwind's first annual operating plan and quarterly business review cadence with the CEO and CFO, creating the company's single view of goals and KPIs.
Led a cross-functional pricing and packaging redesign with Sales, Finance and Product that lifted net revenue retention from 108% to 117%.
Wrote the business case and operating model for a $60M regulated-benefits system replacement for a state agency client.
Ran a citywide KPI program across 9 agencies, presenting monthly performance reviews to deputy mayors.
cover_letter_points: Planning-process ownership at Northwind maps directly to running Ledgerline's annual and quarterly cadence for the COO.
Regulated-environment experience (state benefits, city government) is a credible bridge to compliance-heavy banking and insurance customers.
Name the FS gap honestly and show quick domain ramp-up: e.g. learning DoD acquisition rules at Carrow & Hale.
Show interest in the product: AI agents for regulatory change are a natural next step from AI forecasting deployment.
